title: Stale Product Search Responses
business_scenario: Customer searches for 'Laptop' and then quickly clears or updates the query to 'Mobile'.
symptoms: Search results for older query 'Laptop' arrive later and overwrite the newer search results for 'Mobile'.
reproduction_steps: Trigger search for 'laptop' which has an artificial backend latency of 150ms.
Quickly trigger search for 'mobile' which responds in 10ms.
Observe UI rendering: 'mobile' results appear, and are then overwritten by stale 'laptop' results.
expected_behavior: Only the latest user query determines visible results; older responses must be discarded or aborted.
actual_behavior: Older out-of-order responses overwrite newer search results in public/app.js due to lack of request sequence checks.
root_cause: The search client does not check sequence IDs or abort previous in-flight requests, causing race conditions when query latency varies.
acceptance_criteria: Responses with requestId lower than the latest issued query must be ignored.
reference_fix: Maintain a sequence counter in the search client / service and discard any response where data.requestId < state.lastSearchRequestId, or use AbortController.
regression_tests: Normal single search returns correct matching items.
